description.zh: 结束时间戳，10位。最大查询间隔为31天，即与StartTs的间隔时间不超过31天。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a 10-digit timestamp. The maximum query range is 31 days. The duration between StartTs and EndTs cannot exceed 31 days.

description.zh: 查询时间粒度，枚举值：3600（小时粒度），86400（天粒度）。
description.en: The time granularity of the query. Valid values: 3600 (hour) and 86400 (day).

description.zh: 目前该字段暂未生效，默认返回全部region用量。
description.en: This parameter does not take effect. By default, the usage data of all regions is returned.

description.zh: 开始时间戳，10位。最远可查90天内的数据。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a 10-digit timestamp. You can query data within the last 90 days.
